joinWorkspace.description: A person joins the Acme workspace, introducing their profile.

setPhase.description: A member moves a project into a new phase.

setPartners.description: A member records the number of partner organisations on a project.

completeProject.description: A member closes a project, recording its outcome.

createTask.description: A member creates a task, assigning it within a project.

changeStatus.description: An actor moves a task to another status.

updateProgress.description: A member records progress on a task.

uploadFile.description: A member uploads a file into the workspace.

editDocument.description: A member revises a document. The world holds one snapshot of a body, so a revision records that it happened without restating the text.

suggestOutline.description: The system proposes an outline for a new document.

createQuote.description: A member saves an excerpt of a document.

replyToComment.description: A member replies to a comment.

resolveThread.description: A member marks a comment thread settled.

notify.description: The system tells a member about something that happened.

catalogueMaterial.description: The system records a material in the circular-economy catalogue.

catalogueComponent.description: The system records a component, its place in an assembly, and the materials it is made of.

listProduct.description: The system lists a product, with the components it is assembled from and the materials that matter to it.

catalogueService.description: The system records a service and what it applies to.

recordTransaction.description: The ledger records money moving, in or out. The record states no facts: the world holds no accounts for a balance to be a fact about.

recordFlow.description: A lifecycle assessment counts one flow in a tracked item's life — a stage, a site, and the kilograms of CO2e it carried.
